title: 16S Illumina Primer Plate Compression
author: Rodolfo A Salido Benitez
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.uatesen

steps.title: Set up epMotion worktable
steps.instruction: Follow the provided diagram to arrange the epMotion 5075 (Liquid Handling, Eppendorf, catalog 5075000962) deck.

steps.title: Load tip boxes on deck
steps.instruction: Place four (4) boxes of 0.2–10 µL epT.I.P.S. tips with filters onto deck slots A2, A3, A4, and A5.

steps.title: Place primer plates
steps.instruction: Position Primer Plates 1, 2, 3, and 4 on deck slots B2, B3, B4, and B5 respectively.

steps.title: Add destination plate
steps.instruction: Place the LDV destination plate on deck slot C2.

steps.title: Remove lids and foils
steps.instruction: Take off the box lids from the tip boxes and the foil seals from all plates.

steps.title: Import and run protocol
steps.instruction: Import the protocol file “LDV_181003_115538.export6” (Application_10uLTips Primer compression 4‑96 to 1‑384) into epBlue software version 40.6 or later, then execute it.

steps.title: Automated primer transfer
steps.instruction: The program will transfer 9 µL of each primer from the source plates to the destination plate according to the layout described in the protocol.io document.
